testCase.name: [dev] S11 Nursing Home keeps the last two visits, seeded: three archived visits plus one that rotates when the list opens

descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D6 · P1 · Daniela

转录 / 保留时长和 UAT 3.6 不一致：归档 48 小时（不是 36）、养老院保留 3 次访视（不是 2 次）、「Earlier sessions」和「Most Recent」不带日期、快速口述框永不过期、保留时长写死在代码里（是不是要做成配置）

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-16/S10, TC-16/S14, TC-16/S23, TC-16/S27, OAT-04/S19, TC-11/S28, TC-04/S10

思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S11 「养老院保留最近两次就诊，seed 出来的：三次存档的就诊，加上一次在打开列表时轮换的」 Nursing Home keeps the last two visits, seeded: three archived visits plus one that rotates when the list opens

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Nursing Home: transcripts are kept for the last two visits.（UAT 3.6；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 How it works 1；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both.（UAT 3.3；TFA-92594 AC 2）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given {snfResident} with three archived '· Visit notes' rows (archivedAt 21, 14 and 7 days ago: 'QA16-N-R1', 'QA16-N-R2', 'QA16-N-R3') and encounterNotes 'QA16-N-R4' with encounterEditedAt = now−13 h (past the 12 h Nursing Home window)

When Switch to Nursing Home (snf:applyLifecycle runs with the server's Date.now()), open the resident's Encounter tab, look without opening anything, then open the newest row

Then R4 is listed as '<13 h ago> · Visit notes' with no manual step and has left the working box. Only R3 and R4 are listed; R1 and R2 are gone

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 Nursing Home 'last two visits' and TFA-92594 AC 2. Under either reading of Q3 (two archived visits, or the current visit plus the one before) only R3 + R4 remain: R4 is the latest visit and there is none newer. cp1 (collapsed): mustContain '{Mon D, 7 days ago} · Visit notes', '{Mon D, 13 h ago} · Visit notes'; …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U26；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92594 ready for qa

养老院住户的既往转录列出了三次访视，不是最近两次。

A Nursing Home resident's Prior Encounter Transcripts list three past visits instead of the last two.

依据：Allure ea82a7c8. Ledger #26 U26: SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3 in lifecycle.ts. Dev report §3 row 1: Daniela decides whether the code or the UAT changes. TC-16 Q3/Q12 are open. TFA-94699 (in progress) says 'keep the last two visits'. The seed's label format mismatch is ours, not the product's.

重复的（同一个问题，在这条看）：TC-16/S14

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
